records.generationPrompt:
Use case: productivity-visual. Generate a beautifully typeset Japanese enterprise ICON STYLE COMPARISON BOARD as one original raster image, not a photograph of a page. Clean restrained design, sharp Japanese glyphs and large clearly separated icon examples. Portrait approximately 2160x3072, high resolution. Full opaque warm-white viewing ground #FCFBF8 is explicitly required for this comparison board; it is not a standalone icon asset.
Use a disciplined TWO-COLUMN by SIX-ROW editorial grid below a compact header, left-to-right row-major ordering. Thin pale-blue dividers, ample but efficient margins, no cards, no decorative bases. Each style cell has exactly one bold Japanese number/name at top, then FOUR aligned examples, with their four labels below: 文書 / 協働 / 自動化 / 安全. Each cell's symbols are large and optical weights are balanced. Keep titles out of the artwork; no extra brand or English names. No footer tiny print.
SAME FOUR THEMES in every cell, in this exact order:
1 文書: an upright document page, upper-right folded corner, three content lines, one checkbox.
2 協働: exactly two equal human bust symbols, shared speech bubble with three dots.
3 自動化: one eight-tooth gear with ONE central lightning bolt.
4 安全: one shield with a central checkmark.
The only physical-metaphor exception is style11: paper stack + binder clip / two office chairs sharing a small meeting table / a compact motor with one connected steel gear / physical padlock. These are the same four concepts rendered as real objects, not stock glyph sculptures.
COMMON PALETTE: ink #0D2046, primary #1456D9, primarySoft #DCE7FA, slate #52637A, neutral white #FCFBF8. Restrained natural neutral edges are allowed only when required by a material; no brown or gold accents, no arbitrary rainbow. Palette stays consistent across both boards. Do not homogenize drawing treatments: each row below specifies a deliberate different recipe.
No arbitrary decorative stand, plinth, square backing patch, floor scene or giant cast shadow under any icon. For style-dependent shadows, subtle short contact shadows only. Maintain readable recognizable silhouettes, non-overlapping icons and perfectly consistent labels.

EXACT SUBHEADER: "01–12 基本表現と立体表現"
Third header line: "同じテーマ・同じ配色で比較"

CELL 02, exact title "02 フラット": Flat filled primary-color silhouettes with clean negative-space details, smooth simple geometric forms. No enclosing outlines, gradients, dimension or shadows.

CELL 03, exact title "03 線と塗り": Flat frontal strong ink outlines, finer internal strokes, primary and primarySoft solid color regions. No gradients or dimension. Simplify structural detail to compact pictograms.

CELL 04, exact title "04 ネガティブスペース": Bold continuous ink or primary silhouettes with incisive negative-space apertures that carry the meaning. Strong figure-ground shapes, no enclosing contours, surface texture or dimensional lighting. Keep apertures transparent where intended.

CELL 05, exact title "05 テクニカル線画": Precise frontal technical line drawings, graded ink exterior and finer internal structural strokes. Very restrained construction guides only when useful; no microtext, wash, modeled shading or invented engineering detail.

CELL 06, exact title "06 テクニカルスポット": Flat 2D explanatory line-and-fill illustration, graded ink outlines and fine structural detail. Restrained primary, primarySoft and neutral flat color regions, with minimal graphic tonal accents only to explain structure. Human heads and clothing stay flat. No spherical gradients, inflated volume, plastic shine, bevels, extrusion, ambient occlusion or cast shadows. More object structure than a generic pictogram, never a 3D material render.

CELL 07, exact title "07 グラデーション": Crisp frontal 2D silhouettes with controlled primary-to-primarySoft gradients on flat faces. No actual extrusion, rounded plastic volume, hard enclosing outlines or glow.

CELL 08, exact title "08 アイソメトリック": Consistent shallow 30-degree isometric projection, ink linework, flat primary and light front/side planes, restrained visible vector extrusion. No soft material shading, gloss or supporting platform.

CELL 09, exact title "09 マット3D": Fully modeled rounded volume with moderate real thickness, refined matte satin surfaces in current palette roles, consistent upper-left studio light, low-intensity semi-transparent close shadows. No inflated toy forms, decorative plinths or glossy plastic.

CELL 10, exact title "10 浅いレリーフ": Front-facing shallow stacked relief with broad flat front planes, two or three thin layers and short close shadows at overlaps. Use current palette roles; not fully rounded 3D or torn fiber collage.

CELL 11, exact title "11 実物のミニチュア": Credible realistic product miniatures of the current brief's physical objects. Real material joins, functional construction and restrained studio lighting. For abstract ideas, choose and record a meaningful physical-object metaphor rather than sculpting an arbitrary glyph. Preserve the current meaning; no room, floor plate, decorative base or brand.

CELL 12, exact title "12 ペン画": Mature hand-drawn pen miniatures with fine line-weight variation, intentional light hatching and restrained primarySoft color wash inside forms. No messy doodles or illustrative background.

CRITICAL DISTINCTIVENESS AND QUALITY CHECKS:
03 is SIMPLE flat line/fill pictograms. 06 is also FLAT 2D, but with graded outer/inner line hierarchy, paper margin details, subtle flat collar seams, fine gear hub structure and an explanatory shield inner line. Never spherical heads, inflated shoulders, bevels, extruded faces, plastic gloss or 3D shading in06. The four subjects do not change.
07 uses gradients only across FLAT 2D regions, with crisp silhouette edges: no rounded-ball lighting, bevel, shine, surface thickness or 3D cast shadow. It must not resemble09.
08 uses consistent isometric geometric projection, flat planar side faces and vector linework. 09 has genuinely rounded matte 3D volume and physical thickness with soft studio lighting. 10 has ONLY two or three very THIN stacked planar layers, near-frontal view, broad completely flat top faces and tight short overlap shadows; it must not look like09's inflated volumes.
05 is precise structural pen linework with a few tidy construction marks. 12 is mature editorial pen variation and controlled hatching, not construction grids. No messy sketch lines or watercolor outside shapes.
15 is THIN paper collage layers and subtle fibers, not crumpled 3D masses. 17 is folded angular creases/facets, not torn collage. 19 shows thin page-edge layers/bookcloth;21 shows leather grain/debossing;22 shows individual directional stitches and cut textile edges with no backing patch. These three must have visibly different materials.
All styles must exactly match their number, title and treatment. No duplicate/missing cells, no mixing style treatments in one row. Crisp correct Japanese labels, four distinct icons per style. Numbers are identifiers, not measured usage ranks.
